text: The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No.: DIVUD/LND/ACQUI/13/6-2. DIVUD/LND/ACQUI/WTR/16 Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/18/2020/WS/240. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, As Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands/Servitudes which are required for a public purpose:

Description of the lands or servitudes to be acquired:- Three allotments of land, referred in the sub schedule in Sheet No. 01, Block 02, Cadastral map 421361, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in Ihalagama Village in No. 1504 Ihalagama South Grama Niladhari Division in Udubaddawa Divisional Secretary's Division in Kurunegala District of North Western Province. Sub Schedule Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Meegahamulawaththa alias Siyambalagahamulawaththa, Koongahamulahena; Claimed by: R. P. Indra Padmalatha, Naththandiya Road, Udubaddawa; Extent: 0.0502 Hectare.

Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Ela; Claimed by: The Government; Extent: 0.0042 Hectare. Lot No. 3 Name of the Land: Koongahamulahena; Claimed by: R. P. Indra Padmalatha, Naththandiya Road, Udubaddawa; Extent: 0.0215 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, on the 13.03.2024 at 10.00 a.m., and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 06.03.2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/Servitude the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. Nංඅඎ඄ൺ D. Dൺඌൺඇൺඒൺ඄ൾ, Divisional Secretary, Udubaddawa. Divisional Secretariat, Udubaddawa. On 26th January, 2024. EOG 01 - 0222
